edges.method: studs of wheel holder plate clutch underside of black chassis plate (attached from below in step 8)
studs of wheel holder plate clutch underside of black chassis plate (attached from below in step 8)
ladder plate attached sideways at the front (grille)

notes: Positions and exact layouts are my best-effort reconstruction from small isometric pictures; some placements are assumptions.

Fix: the wheel holders p17/p18 are added in step 8 but clutch the UNDERSIDE of the step-1 chassis plate p15. Listing them in p15's rests_on breaks step order (they come later), so I removed that and instead give them null positions (attached from below, not stacked on the grid), joined to p15 through other_joins. p15 now has empty rests_on and is the lowest piece at layer 0 (all layers shifted down by 1).
Steps counted 1-12 as printed; the small inset sub-step for the clear 1x2 plate is counted within step 10.
The ladder plate p16 and wheels/tyres are off-grid (null position); each tyre is on a wheel, and wheels are paired onto the holders.
Front of the truck is at x=0 (ladder grille end); dump bed is at the rear.
